changes.text: Cells are `role="gridcell"` inside `role="grid"` > `role="row"` groups instead of `role="button"`, and the whole grid is one tab stop: arrows, Home and End move between cells (roving `tabindex`). Arrow keys stay physical under `dir="rtl"`.
`null` cells are no longer `aria-hidden`: they are focusable gridcells named "<row> vs <column>: no value", so keyboard navigation keeps the 2-D shape of the matrix.
A min→max legend (the formatted `domain` ends plus a 5-step `--ss-primary` opacity ramp) renders under the grid when `showValues` is `false`, so intensity is not the only cue. No new prop.
Value text stays legible on every cell strength: the `--ss-fg` glyphs get a `--ss-bg` halo (was about 1.1:1 on the strongest cells).

The tooltip is `aria-hidden` instead of `role="status"` and closes on Escape, including one opened by hover. The in-cell value text is `aria-hidden` too, so a value is no longer announced twice, and cells no longer show a pointer cursor.

New component: a value-intensity matrix with row and column headers (`rows`, `columns`, `values`), where cell opacity over `--ss-primary` encodes the value and `null` cells stay blank. Ships with `domain`, `valueFormat`, `showValues`, `xLabel` / `yLabel`, `cellSize`, `tooltip`, `summary` and `size`.
